tags.name: api
tags.description: «IA» over OCS, the API its own pages read (gestion-aio#162, API contract). Consumers send `OCS-APIRequest: true`, which is also the CSRF protection, and get the OCS envelope back. Every route is attribute-routed and rate-limited, and is either open to any signed-in person, who may see what being checked inside the action, or the admin page's own, for admins and the groups it is delegated to (MetadataTest holds all of it).
